optimizer_status.M2_used: Best fixed-tau profile point; every fixed-tau amplitude optimization converged from both declared starts. Final3D line search failed without changing the selected profile point. This is not a continuous/global optimum certificate.

finding.time_structure_increment: M2 improves full held-out restricted objective by417.1291459301592 relative to M1, including covariance and nuisance-information determinant terms. It is evidence for useful temporal covariance within these declared models, not identification of a unique physical source.
finding.tau_not_identified: Objective decreases throughout declared0.2..2s profile and reaches the upper bound.2s is a frozen working-model value, not a measured physical correlation time.
finding.validation_scale_not_calibrated: M1/M2 held-out residual cost per nominal DOF is0.5764/0.5484 versus0.9407/0.9418 on calibration. The complete model is broader than the held-out residual energy indicates; no source-group/white-versus-code attribution follows from this aggregate alone.
finding.not_a_navigation_or_integer_success: No navigation, reference, best-integer fitting, partial-subset search, Q replacement or acceptance-quantile change. Restricted likelihood removes continuous integer nuisance, so this result does not establish integer-lattice support, tail calibration, AR reliability or p/v improvement.
finding.next_joint_model_implication: Temporal physical-SD covariance has held-out evidence beyond white inflation. Any research integration must put the same source-identified beta process and white SD covariance into raw proposal likelihood and common IMU/contact/navigation state, preserve physical source lifetime across integer slips, and retain this unqualified scale/time boundary. A nonempty domain alone cannot qualify it.

mathematics.geometry: Fixed original-Q whitening followed by parameter-independent L_j B_j=0 contrasts. No theta-dependent contrast normalization is omitted.
mathematics.covariance: Within-epoch source white covariance I+sigma_white^2 H_j H_j.T and stationary SD beta OU covariance across actual times/pivots. beta is keyed by signal identity independent of integer arc.
mathematics.REML: Kalman innovation whitening applied to y and all fixed physical integer design columns as multiple RHS; one QR removes those continuous nuisance coordinates. Objective=cost+logdet innovation covariance+logdet whitened integer information.
mathematics.small_window_equivalence: 50-epoch M0/white/beta examples match full dense cost and both determinant terms to at most5.92e-12. Original-Q cost also matches the earlier integer-annihilating difference diagnostic.
mathematics.physical_identity_check: One pivot-change plus actual integer-slip synthetic identity case passes: four physical SD beta sources persist while the integer rank changes to four. Direct Python test function executed; configured runtime lacks pytest.
mathematics.integration_api_consistency: Added raw incidence/full covariance APIs after fitting without changing the fitted likelihood function bodies. Original, white, beta and total covariance components match the existing fixed-contrast likelihood on the pivot/slip case; code rows remain zero and beta cross-slip covariance survives.

integration_api.incidence: physical_source_incidence(block, source_signals=None) -> PhysicalSourceIncidence(source_signals, D). Original code rows zero; phase target +1/pivot -1; source identity omits integer arc token.
integration_api.window_covariance: assemble_source_noise_covariance(blocks, parameters, source_signals=None) -> SourceNoiseCovariance(source_signals, source_incidence, row_slices, times_s, original, white, beta, total).
integration_api.components: original=blockdiag(original Q); white=blockdiag(sigma_w^2 D_i D_i.T); beta_ij=sigma_beta^2 exp(-abs(t_i-t_j)/tau) D_i D_j.T. Source errors and scales are in meters.
integration_api.scope: Dense assembly only for short proposal windows; long calibration uses the Kalman multiple-RHS evaluator. These APIs do not implement coupled multi-sphere lower bounds or qualify candidates.
